items.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
items.summary: South Korea’s central bank raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, its highest level in two years, citing above-target inflation and renewed rises in Seoul housing prices.
